verdict.rationale: Tavily publishes its Python SDK source in a public GitHub repository (tavily-ai/tavily-python), so part of the product's client code can be read. Nothing in the evidence states which license covers it, and the core search, extract, crawl and research service shows no open source at all. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license, open source for the core API service, and independent confirmation of licensing terms.
